name: Splendor of Office
body:
School evocation [light]; Level legendary inquisitor 4
Duration 1 round/caster level or see text

This spell functions as judgment light, except that an legendary inquisitor can only cast it if she has a 1st-level office ability active or activated one in the same round. When she casts this spell, it causes one or more of the following effects based on one or more office abilities the inquisitor activated in the same round. Splendor of office has no effect on abilities from more than one office at the same time.

Blasting: Emerald light emanates from the caster. Allies in the area gain evasion, or improved evasion if they already have it.
Censoring: Pink light emanates from the caster. Allies in the area gain a +4 sacred bonus against charm and compulsion effects.
Confession: Dark red light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area are staggered.
Damnation: Black light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area suffer 3 points of bleeding damage for 1d4 rounds.
Debasement: Ashen light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area suffer a -5 penalty on Strength-based ability and skill checks.
Faltering: Opalescent light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area suffer a -5 penalty on Dexterity-based ability and skill checks.
God-Fearing: Indigo light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area are frightened for 1d4 round or shaken if they succeed at a Will saving throw.
Invocation: As the judgment light spell’s effects, with the following exceptions: resiliency increases the inquisitor’s DR by 3; resistance increases the inquisitor’s energy resistance by 5; and smiting makes the allies’ weapons count as cold iron, mithral, and silver in addition to other properties.
Judgment: As the judgment light spell’s effects.
Karma: Rosy-green light emanates from the caster. Each time enemies in the area damage the caster’s allies, they must succeed at a Will save or suffer one-half this damage themselves.
Pardon: Rosy-gold light emanates from the caster. Allies in the area are under the effect of sanctuary for 1d4 rounds.
Pestilence: Bronze light emanates from the caster. Allies in the area gain a +5 save bonus against disease effect.
Punishment: Dark grey light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area only gain magic bonuses to their Armor Class from armor and shields (so a +1 studded leather armor would only provide a +1 bonus on AC).
Sacred Scripture: Red-gold light emanates from the caster. Enemies in the area suffer a -5 penalty on counterspell and concentration checks.
Studied Target: Pearly light emanates from the caster. Allies in the area receive ½ of the inquisitor’s studied target bonus.
Tithing Fund: Steely light emanates from the caster. Allies in the area reduce their encumbrance by 1 step.
Trial: Rainbow light emanates from the caster. All enemies in the area are subjected to the same trial of the main opponent, as if declared by a 10th-level legendary inquisitor.
Uncertainty: Auburn light emanates from the inquisitor. Enemies in the area only inflict half damage with their weapons and suffer the other half themselves.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
